# WO-187: Guard Open Graph metadata on the developer reference pages (CP-32)
Status: open (ready; worktree prepared)
Vendor: codex
Agent: web-designer
Owner contact: Nora Bennett (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3
Assigned to: Nora's choice (Amara Okoye suggested; she wrote WO-183 on the same page)
Source: CP-32 / freemyid-pm#149, accepted by Morgan 2026-11-08 after WO-170/171 art (Iris, redo 7e80138) was placed by in-house (Leo, d225855)

## Goal
Add an offline built-site test that checks the rendered Open Graph metadata on `/developers/cli/` and `/developers/config/`, so each page keeps pointing at its own image with its approved alt text.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Read the built site in `web/dist` (reuse the existing `web_dist` pattern in `tests/conftest.py`; the filename must start with `test_` under tests/codex, so mark it `web_dist` explicitly or follow how other tests/codex web tests do it).
- For each of the two pages, assert: `og:image` resolves to the page's own image (`og-developers-cli` / `og-developers-config`), never `og-home` and never the other page's image; `og:image:width` 1200 and `og:image:height` 630; `og:image:alt` equals the `og_alt` text for that page in `site_src/pages.yaml` (read it from that file, don't copy the string); the referenced image file exists in the build output.
- Only these two routes. No copy, SEO or marketing assertions beyond the above.
- No real personal data, no network, no new dependencies. If the built output disagrees with pages.yaml, do not edit any source: report to Nora with file:line, and keep only the affected assertion as a strict xfail with that reason.
- From the prepared worktree, build the site in a subshell so you stay at the worktree root (`(cd web && pnpm build)`, after linking `web/node_modules` the way earlier Codex web WOs did, removing the link afterwards), then run `PYTHONPATH=src FREEMYID_REQUIRE_WEB_DIST=1 ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/codex/test_cx_developer_og_metadata.py` and `ruff check tests/codex/test_cx_developer_og_metadata.py`; record exact results in `VENDOR_STATUS.md`.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- `tests/codex/test_cx_developer_og_metadata.py` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

In-house already added `tests/codex/test_cx_developer_og_metadata.py` to the `pull_request` and `push` path filters in `.github/workflows/pages.yml`, so the built-site CI job (`pytest -m web_dist`) runs this test on its own PR. The vendor does not touch the workflow.

## Out of scope / do not touch
Pages, `site_src/pages.yaml`, `web/src/**`, art files, existing tests (including `tests/test_web_og_images.py`), `src/`, project config.

## Check-in plan
Worktree `.vendor-wt/wo-187` on branch `vendor/wo-187`, based on local main d225855 (contains d225855; origin/main does not yet). Report in the worktree status file and issue #149. Nora summarizes in `docs/vendor/CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md`.
